title: Universal Visual Context & Fast Build
message: GabAI v0.3.5 brings universal multi-subject visual context for all literature, history, science, math, and reading terms with Overview, Real-World, and Diagrams & Charts filters.
changelog:
• Universal Visual Context: Works across ALL academic disciplines (Literature, History, Science, Math, Social Studies)
• Universal Perspective Chips: [Overview], [Real-World], and [Diagrams & Charts]
• Dynamic Query Engine: No longer restricts or hardcodes science/diagram search terms
• Fullscreen Lightbox Dialog: Tap any visual for high-res fullscreen inspection with dark backdrop
• Strictly Enforced Updates: Guaranteed up-to-date client builds without bypass
